scenarios.name: Recovery Drive
scenarios.blurb: Buried in the midfield with a fresh set underneath you. Track position is gone -- go and take it back.

scenarios.name: Safety Car Gamble
scenarios.blurb: The safety car is out and the pit lane just got cheap. Take the free stop, or hold the track position you have.

scenarios.name: Cliff Edge
scenarios.blurb: Second place, two seconds off the lead, on inters that are past their cliff, and the rain is getting heavier. Hang on to what is left, or gamble on a stop you may not get back.

scenarios.name: Rain Call
scenarios.blurb: Still dry, but a damp spell is a few laps away and you are on slicks. Box early for inters, or stay out and gamble that the shower is short.

scenarios.name: VSC Gamble
scenarios.blurb: You are P5 in the midfield, on tired inters with no stop made, and a virtual safety car has just made the pit lane cheap. Take the stop now, or stay out and hold your track position.

scenarios.name: Sprint Finish
scenarios.blurb: Six laps of the sprint left, a virtual safety car out, and you are P5. The softs in P3 are already past the cliff. Push now and go and get them.

scenarios.name: Red Flag Restart
scenarios.blurb: Red flag from P4, twenty laps to go, and everyone gets a free tyre change. Pick the right restart tyre and the win is on.

scenarios.name: Lantern Gamble
scenarios.inspiredBy: A night street race where an early stop met a perfectly timed safety car.
scenarios.blurb: Safety car under the floodlights, twelve laps on your mediums, and the pit lane just got cheap. Stop now and gamble on the restart, or keep your place in the queue.

scenarios.name: Desert Two-Stop
scenarios.inspiredBy: The tyre wars, when the boldest call was one more stop than everyone else.
scenarios.blurb: One stop down, tyres already fading in the heat. Stop again and chase, or nurse it home.

scenarios.name: Slicks or Stay
scenarios.inspiredBy: Drying-track afternoons where the first car on slicks won the race.
scenarios.blurb: Still on wet-weather tyres and the line is drying fast. Be the first onto slicks, or wait for the track to come to you.

scenarios.name: Hold the Train
scenarios.inspiredBy: A street-circuit leader who kept a faster car behind on dying tyres for the last stint.
scenarios.blurb: Leading with ten to go on worn mediums, and a faster car half a second behind you on fresher hards. Defend to the flag, or stop and fight back.

scenarios.name: Undercut Duel
scenarios.inspiredBy: The great undercut duels, decided by a single lap of timing.
scenarios.blurb: Second, within two seconds of the leader, both of you on your first set. Who blinks first?

scenarios.name: From the Back
scenarios.inspiredBy: A champion's recovery drive from the back of the grid.
scenarios.blurb: Near the back on fresh hards with most of the race to run. Pick your stints and carve through.
